Hi Sam — great conversation earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and a proposed next step:

- Primary success metrics: avg. query latency under 150ms and 95% reduction in manual tagging time.

Next step: schedule a 30-minute product intro (high-level demo + infra Q&A). Who from your side should join from Product/Platform/Infra? You mentioned Priya (Product) and an infra lead — I included a few slots below in PT and added a flexible option if nothing fits.

Proposed slots (PT):
1) Tue 2027-08-17 10:00 — 10:30 PT
2) Wed 2027-08-18 14:00 — 14:30 PT
3) Thu 2027-08-19 09:00 — 09:30 PT (compact slot for execs)

If those don't work, we can do a 10:00 — 10:30 PT window any weekday next week.

Prep & asks:
- Please confirm attendees and any high-priority infra/security questions you want covered (SOC 2 scope, data residency).
- I attached quick post-call notes for reference (post-discovery-notes.pdf).

I'll loop in Neha from our team to lock a time and nominate an SE for the call.

Thanks,
